workflow: Open Tigerair Taiwan official booking engine
If Waiting Room appears, report manual_required instead of trying to bypass it
Collect fare and add-on state needed to understand the real total without selecting paid extras
special_rules: The official booking engine can use a waiting room and time-limited checkout session.
Do not treat a base fare without mandatory taxes/fees as a comparable final total.
Do not autonomously add baggage, seats, meals or other paid ancillaries.
revalidate: Start a fresh exact search immediately before human checkout because session/fare validity is short.
failure_policy: Do not guess an all-in fare from base fare cards.
Return explicit blocker if exact total cannot be verified.
